description: Derived from AGSC-05-38: a site vocabulary that meets conditions (a) to (g) raises nothing. The file at `domain.vocabulary` declares one ontology, puts its class `dom:Engine` and its two properties in its own namespace, makes the class a subclass of the item class `asc:Concept`, makes both properties sub-properties of `asc:uses` with each other as inverse, gives every term a label, declares no domain or range, and declares the other vocabularies' terms it names by one type triple each. The configuration declares `spec_version` 1.1.0 and the file.
